subject: Add pipeline YAML auto-generation to converter
description: Add generate_dab_pipeline_yaml() function to sas_dbx.py. After successful conversion, auto-generate a pipeline YAML file in resources/pipelines/pipeline_{base_name}.yml. YAML should reference ${var.developer_id}, ${resources.schemas.*}, and follow DAB conventions. Include tags for source_file, developer_id, pipeline_type.
